title: Local AI is the ecosystem and SRS is its tool; the real Mozilla pitch is SRS, and the editor is a front door showing tools without vendor lock-in (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Local Ai is not just the AI, its the ecosystem. SRS is the tool for the ecosystem. The Editor is a proof of concept. The real pitch for Mozilla is not the editor, it's SRS. The editor is a front door that shows how we can built tools without vendor lock-in.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-06, answering what local AI means for the community the editor is for; recorded verbatim.
